buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses COMMERCIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS- 2026001419 In addition to the GeM GTC Non comprehensive AMC of Canon Copier for a period of Two Years. 1. Kindly attach the MSE certificate (if applicable) for relevant category and MII declaration on y our letter head (format attached in ATC document) Mandatorily.

2. Technical Specifications (Annexure B, attached) and required services are as per the attached documents in the Bid. Attach the relevant supporting documents with the bid to confirm the c ompliance of all technical specifications. Kindly upload the same with authorized signatory wit h seal. 3. This is a Single packet bid for Non comprehensive AMC. Price related details with detailed price brea kup i.e. taxes, product cost, any other charges, etc. shall be provided along with the bid. The requi red price break up format is attached in ATC document. Kindly attach the spare parts quotatio n mandatorily as per Annexure A (attached), the price for spare parts is for commitment only, this shall not be included in the GeM price bid quotation. 4. DOWN-TIME COMPENSATION: In case the break-down calls are not attended in time, i.e., within 24 hour s of our intimation, down-time compensation at the rate of 0.5% of the Annual Maintenance Charges per d ay shall be recovered from you subject to a maximum of 10%. 5. FALL CLAUSE: The charges quoted by you shall in no event exceed the lowest charges at which you und ertake AMC of identical description to any other party during the period of this contract. If at any time, dur ing the said period, you reduce such charges of such software to any other customers, it shall be forthwith notified to us and the charges payable under the contract for servicing done after the date of coming into f orce of such reduction of charges shall stand correspondingly reduced. 6. ADDITIONS / DELETIONS: We reserve the right to add/delete any number of similar equipment to this Contract during the currency of the Contract. 7. Payment: Payment for each visit will be made within 30 days after satisfactory completion of each servi ce against your invoice accompanied with service call report duly certified by competent authority of IPR C/ISRO on pro rata basis will be released after completing successful completion of AMC. 8. Delivery terms: Onsite, IPRC, Mahendragiri. 9. Period of Contract: Non-Comprehensive AMC for Two years. (Details as per Attached specification docu ment) 10. Terms and Conditions for Spare part supply during AMC: A. The price of the spares shall be valid thorough out the AMC period. B. Delivery immediately upon requirement at IPRC Mahendragiri. C. Payment: The invoice shall be raised for payment of spares, and shall be paid within 30 days after installati on and acceptance and after duly certified by the focal point and approved by the division head. The suppl y shall be routed through IPRC, Stores. The defective parts removed from the machine shall be IPRC prope rty and same shall be retuned through IPRC, Stores. D. Installation of spares shall be carried out during the AMC visit/breakdown visit and no extra visit is applicab le 11. General Terms and Conditions: a. The contractor shall make his own arrangement for Canteen, Transport, safety of personne l, Medial and other amenities and complete the work within the contract period. b. In the event of any damages to our property or personal injury to our / your personnel due to the negligence of your employees, the responsibility shall solely rest with you. c. Your Services Engineer shall adhere to all the required safety precautions for the execution of the works and safety of personnel and installations. He shall indemnify the Department against any claims whatsoever from any individuals / authorities for any accidents, during the period of the contract. d. The preventive maintenance shall be attended to between from 9.00 A.M to 5.00 P.M on all working days (Monday to Friday). In case of exigency, the same shall be attended beyo nd office hours and on holidays. e. You shall observe the safety and security regulations of IPRC and loss or damage incurred t o IPRC staff on account of your failure if any, to observe the safety and security regulation

s will be to your’s account. f. All laws relating to the employment of labour shall be strictly adhered to IPRC shall not be held responsible on any manner. g. You shall deploy only qualified / experienced Indian Nationals. You shall follow the security guidelines of IPRC. h. Service Engineer shall report to the work between 9.00 AM to 5.00 PM on working days (M onday to Friday). The date of his visit should be intimated to the Contact Person, two days in advance for arrangement of entry pass. i. Necessary Police verification in respect of all your personnel shall be carried out by you at your cost enabling entry in to our premises. j. Subletting of contract is not allowed. 12. Secrecy: Any information obtained in the course of execution of the Purchase Order by the supplier, his a gents or consultants or advisors or employees engaged by the supplier, etc., as to any matter whatsoever, which would directly or indirectly be of use to any enemy of India, should be treated as secret and shall no t, at any time, be communicated to any person. Any breach of the aforesaid conditions shall entitle the Ce ntre/Unit to cancel the Purchase Order and if necessary to go ahead with the purchase or authorize the pur chase of the stores at the risk and cost of the supplier, in addition to any other penal action it may take at its discretion. The supplier, his agents or consultants or advisors or employees, etc., shall not use the store s items or the name of ISRO/DOS for any publicity purpose through any public media like press, radio, TV o r internet. Drawings, specifications, prototypes, samples and such other information furnished to the contr actor/supplier relating to the supply/sub-system/equipment etc., shall be held by the contractor/supplier in confidence and shall not be divulged to any third party without the prior written consent of the Centre/Unit. 13. DISPUTE RESOLUTION MECHANISM: a. CONCILIATION: Notwithstanding anything contained in this contract, any disputes or diff erences whatsoever, which are to be settled amicably between the parties, shall be resolved through Conciliation. b. MEDIATION: Any disputes or differences, which are not settled amicably through Concilia tion, then either of the parties, may approach for mediation to settle under Mediation Act, 2023.The procedure is to be followed as prescribed in the Mediation Act, 2023 amended fr om time to time. c. ARBITRATION: In the event of any dispute/s, difference/s or claim/s arising out of or relat ing to the interpretation and application of the Contract, such dispute/s or difference/s or c laim/s shall be settled amicably by mutual consultations of the good Offices of the respecti ve Parties and recognizing their mutual interests attempt to reach a solution satisfactory t o both the parties. If such a resolution is not possible, within 30 days from the date of recei pt of written notice of the existence of such dispute/s, then the unresolved dispute/s or diff erence/s or claim/s shall be referred to the Sole Arbitrator appointed by the Parties by mut ual consent in accordance with the rules and procedures of Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996 as amended fromtime to time. The arbitration shall be conducted in Bengaluru in the Arbitration and Conciliation Centre - Bengaluru (Domestic and International) as per its rules and regulations. The expenses for the Arbitration shall be shared equally or as may be det ermined by the Arbitrator. The considered and written decision of the Arbitrator shall be fin al and binding between the Parties. The applicable language for Arbitration shall be Englis h only. Work under the Contract shall be continued by the CONTRACTOR during the pende ncy of arbitration proceedings, without prejudice to a final adjustment in accordance with t he decision of the Arbitrator unless otherwise directed in writing by the DEPARTMENT or un less the matter is such that the works cannot be possibly continued until the decision (whe ther final or interim) of the Arbitrator is obtained. Arbitration will be a method of dispute re solution in contracts where dispute value is lesser than Rs.10 Crore. 14. PLEASE MENTION OUR Internal reference number “ADY05 2026001419’’ in all your communica tions enabling us to respond promptly.
